ev.q: incidence rates were at least two times greater for blacks than whites for eight of 42 nationally notifiable diseases
For gonorrhea, the incidence rate for blacks was 24 times greater, at 570.4 per 100,000 population
Racial data were provided for 70% of cases
a total of 1,362,628 cases were reported
the incidence rate for blacks was at least twice as high as the rate for whites
CDC reviewed 2002 data from the Nationally Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS)

methods_quotes.q: incidence rates were reported by race where five or more cases were reported
Population data from states in which diseases were not notifiable or disease data were not available were excluded from rate calculations.
For this analysis, notifiable diseases were reviewed for completeness of racial data where 25 or more cases were reported
